comment: Synthetic mutant for Issue 6 (message_decrypt_prekey skips pre_key_store.remove_pre_key): provisioned with a one-time pre-key (with_opk = true), Alice initiates session A1 and sends m1, which Bob receives (leaving one-time-pre-keys/3 on disk under the mutant while clean v0.105.4 deletes it); Alice clears her session, initiates session A2 reusing the same one-time pre-key bundle, and sends m2, which the mutant accepts (exit 0) and clean v0.105.4 rejects (exit 1).
